chunks: It is peace till the dawning of the day.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: The dawn, specifically the time of Fajr prayer
key_terms.مَطْلَعِ: Place of rising, dawn, or emergence

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about peace during the night until dawn?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qadr is interpreted as a divine decree of peace descending upon the believers throughout the night, culminating in the dawn of spiritual awakening. It underscores the significance of Laylat al-Qadr as a period of tranquility and mercy, where the angels and the Spirit descend by God's permission, reinforcing the theme of divine grace during the last third of the night.
